host.missing: Melete is running outside Mnemosyne OS
host.missingBody: Open it from the Mnemosyne canvas. On its own it has no file picker, no model and no vault — nothing it does would be real.
host.vaultFailed: Melete could not open its vault
host.vaultLocked: Walled off — nothing here mixes with your other vaults until you unlock it in the Vault Manager.

library.title: Your courses
library.emptyBody: A PDF, a Word file, a photo of the lecture screen. Melete reads it, files it into its own vault, and turns it into things you can look at and rehearse.
library.pastePlaceholder: Paste the text of your course here…
library.pasteHint: Pasted text has no file behind it: if the storage budget ever fills up, this text is the first thing that cannot be recovered.
library.deleteConfirm: Remove "{{title}}" and everything made from it?
library.deleteDetail: This removes {{cards}} cards, {{maps}} maps and {{quizzes}} quizzes from Melete. The passages already written into the vault stay there — Melete never deletes your memory.

import.ingesting: Filing passage {{done}} of {{total}} into the vault…
import.savingImage: Saving the picture into the vault…
import.failedRead: Melete could not read that file
import.failedOcrHint: It looks like a scan or a photo. Install an OCR engine in Settings → OCR and try again.
import.failedEmpty: That file gave no text at all.
import.imageIndexNote: Whether it becomes searchable depends on image memory being on in Settings → Images. Melete cannot turn that on for you.
import.photoOcrNote: Melete will also try to read the text on the picture.

gen.partial: Generated from the first part of this course — a long document is read from the top.
gen.noModelBody: Melete asks Mnemosyne's model router, so whatever you set in Settings → Intelligence is what runs here. Nothing answered.
gen.noTextBody: Melete released it to stay inside its storage budget. Import the file again to regenerate.
gen.unusable: The model answered, but not with a usable structure
gen.unusableBody: Small local models fail here most often. Try again, or pick a larger model in Settings → Intelligence.
gen.empty: Nothing to draw from this passage
gen.emptyFlow: This course does not describe a procedure. Melete would rather show nothing than invent one.
gen.emptyCompare: This course contrasts nothing that Melete could put in a table.
gen.emptyGeneric: The model returned a valid but empty answer.
gen.feedbackPlaceholder: too short, add examples, more diagrams...

map.emptyBody: One click and Melete draws the shape of this course: the central idea, its branches, and what hangs off them.

sketch.emptyBody: Melete can draw the process this course describes, a table of what it contrasts, or its chronology.

cards.emptyBody: Melete writes question-and-answer cards from the course, then brings each one back exactly when you are about to forget it.
cards.noneBody: Come back tomorrow — or generate cards from another course.
cards.deleteConfirm: Delete the card "{{front}}"? Its review history goes with it.

quiz.emptyBody: Multiple choice, drawn from this course, with the reason for the right answer and the passage it came from.
quiz.question: Question {{n}} of {{total}}
quiz.reviseNone: Nothing missed — nothing to single out.

digest.emptyBody: The points you must be able to state, and the vocabulary this course uses.
digest.noGlossary: This course carries no vocabulary Melete could isolate.

source.title: What Melete read
source.keptNone: Source text released to stay inside the storage budget.
source.pathNone: No file — this course was pasted in.
source.vaultNone: Not written into the vault yet
source.keptShort: Melete keeps {{kept}} of this course's {{total}} characters for regenerating. The whole text is in the vault; only the copy kept for the model is shorter.

progress.title: Progress
progress.badgesNone: No badge yet — the first one comes with your first course.
progress.storageShed: Storage was full. Melete released the kept source text of {{n}} courses.
progress.storageShedLost: {{n}} of them were pasted text with no file behind them — that text is gone.
progress.storageFull: Melete could not save: the blob weighs {{bytes}} bytes and the host caps it at {{cap}}.

badge.deep-cut: A card in the last box

common.saveFailed: Melete could not save this change
common.notLoaded: Melete has not finished reading its own state — nothing was saved.

docs.emptyTitle: This course has no documents yet
docs.emptyBody: Add the slides, the handout, a photo of the board. They all go into the same course.
docs.removeConfirm: Remove "{{name}}" from this course? What it already wrote into the vault stays there.

plan.emptyBody: Melete reads your documents and proposes a structure - a title, the parts, who teaches it. You correct it, then it becomes yours.
plan.needDocs: Add at least one document first.
plan.title: Title
plan.noSections: No parts. Propose a structure, or this course stays one block.
plan.notLocatedHelp: Melete could not find where this part starts in its document. Generating on it will read the WHOLE document instead - rename it to match the wording the course uses, or leave it and work on the whole course.
plan.notValidatedYet: Proposed by Melete. Nothing is yours until you validate it.
plan.notValidatedNotice: This course has no validated plan, so a generation reads it from the top. Go to Plan to fix that.

intent.title: What you need
intent.body: Answered once, used in every generation afterwards. All of it is optional and all of it stays editable.
intent.goalPlaceholder: exam in three weeks, catching up after an absence...
intent.optional: Not answered. Generation works without it, just less targeted.

store.migrated: Your library was carried over: a course is now a set of documents.

fiche.clickHint: Click a card to see the passage it was drawn from.
fiche.emptyBody: One page: the notions as blocks, the links the course states between them, the vocabulary, and the two or three sentences you must be able to say.

ask.title: Ask this course
ask.body: It searches what Melete kept of this course, and answers only from what it finds there. Nothing from general knowledge.
ask.placeholder: What does the hierarchy of norms say?
ask.nothingFound: Your course does not talk about this in these words
ask.nothingFoundBody: The search matches words, not meaning. Try the terms the course itself uses — or the question really is outside it, and Melete will not answer from anywhere else.
ask.hint: Ask about a definition, a distinction, a condition. The passages used are always shown under the answer.

export.label: Export
export.pdfNote: No PDF button: a cartridge cannot write one. Export HTML and print it to PDF from your browser.
export.pngNote: PNG goes into Melete’s own folder in your vault, not a folder you pick — it is the only image write a cartridge has.

web.badUrl: That is not an https address. The host reads https only.
web.fetchFailed: The page could not be read
web.noText: That page gave almost no text.
web.rule: A web page can feed a sheet, a map or a schema. It is NEVER used to write a quiz: an exam answer must come from what your teacher gave you.
web.noSearch: Melete does not search. You give the address, it reads that page and nothing else.

weak.title: What keeps costing you
weak.body: Measured from your quiz attempts, not from what you told Melete. A topic missed once is not here: one bad answer is a bad day.
weak.none: Nothing has been missed twice yet.
weak.inPrompt: These go into every generation from now on, next to what you said resists you.

ficheEdit.conceptLine: One line saying what it is
ficheEdit.needThree: A sheet needs at least three notions. Below that it is a note, and Melete will not draw it as a page.
